items.title: Darktable
items.notes: Free, open-source RAW editor with non-destructive editing and Lightroom-style workflow.

items.title: RawTherapee
items.notes: Free, powerful non-destructive 32-bit RAW processor with a steep learning curve and granular demosaicing control.

items.title: DxO PhotoLab
items.notes: Paid premium RAW editor known for class-leading DeepPRIME AI noise reduction and unmatched optical lens corrections.

items.title: Luminar Neo
items.notes: Paid photo editor with AI-driven sky replacement, portrait relighting, powerline removal, and generative erase.

items.title: ON1 Photo RAW
items.notes: Paid all-in-one RAW editor and asset manager with no subscription required; includes HDR, focus stacking, and AI masking.

items.title: Corel PaintShop Pro
items.notes: Paid comprehensive budget Photoshop alternative for Windows with raster/vector editing, layers, and AI upsampling.

items.title: ACDSee Photo Studio
items.notes: Paid hybrid digital asset management (DAM) and parametric RAW photo editor with fast batch processing capabilities.

items.title: Skylum Aurora HDR
items.notes: Dedicated HDR merging and tone mapping software with bracket alignment, ghost reduction, and artistic presets.

items.title: Polarr
items.notes: Freemium browser and desktop photo editor packed with custom filter presets, face retouching, and selective adjustments.

items.title: Fotor
items.notes: Freemium online and desktop photo editor featuring 1-tap AI enhancements, design templates, and quick collage tools.

items.title: Pixlr E
items.notes: Free browser-based photo editor with Photoshop-style layer hierarchy, blend modes, clone stamp, and selection tools.

items.title: PhotoDirector (CyberLink)
items.notes: Paid photo editing and animation suite combining RAW workflow, photo animation, AI sky replacement, and light video tools.

items.title: Capture One
items.notes: Industry-standard pro RAW developer and tethering tool renowned for superior skin tone fidelity and color wheel controls.

items.title: Affinity Photo 2
items.notes: High-performance one-time purchase photo editor with non-destructive live filters, full RAW development, and PSD compatibility.

items.title: Adobe Photoshop
items.notes: The industry benchmark for raster image manipulation, compositing, graphic design, and Adobe Firefly generative AI.

items.title: PhotoScape X
items.notes: All-in-one photo editing suite featuring batch resizing/renaming, collage creation, GIF maker, and film effect filters.

items.title: Paint.NET
items.notes: Fast, free Windows image editor supporting layers, unlimited undo, special effects, and a rich third-party plugin ecosystem.

items.title: Photopea
items.notes: Advanced free in-browser Photoshop clone that works offline with direct support for PSD, AI, XD, Sketch, and RAW formats.

items.title: GIMP
items.notes: GNU Image Manipulation Program — veteran open-source raster graphics editor powered by the GEGL image processing engine.

items.title: Krita
items.notes: Premier free and open-source digital painting application with 100+ brush engines, brush stabilizers, and frame-by-frame 2D animation.

items.title: Clip Studio Paint
items.notes: Global industry standard for comics, manga, webtoons, and concept art with 3D poseable reference models and vector ink lines.

items.title: Corel Painter
items.notes: Best-in-class realistic digital art studio replicating oil paints, wet watercolors, chalk, pastels, and physical canvas textures.

items.title: Rebelle 3
items.notes: Hyper-realistic fluid simulation software reproducing authentic real-world watercolor diffusion, drying, and impasto oils.

items.title: ArtRage
items.notes: Tactile, beginner-friendly digital art package simulating thick oil paint blending, smear physics, and textured canvases.

items.title: PaintTool SAI
items.notes: Legendary ultra-lightweight Japanese painting software famed for silky smooth line stabilization, low CPU overhead, and clean anime rendering.

items.title: Autodesk SketchBook
items.notes: Distraction-free sketching interface with customizable brushes, Copic color system, French curves, and perspective grids.

items.title: MyPaint
items.notes: Minimalist, distraction-free digital painting tool with an infinite canvas and natural brush dynamics powered by libmypaint.

items.title: MediBang Paint
items.notes: Free cross-platform digital painting and comic creation software loaded with 1000+ screentones, comic panel splitters, and cloud syncing.

items.title: Inkscape
items.notes: Free, open-source vector graphics editor using W3C standard SVG natively, with robust node editing and path boolean operations.

items.title: Affinity Designer 2
items.notes: Fast one-time purchase vector design suite featuring seamless instant switching between vector and pixel raster personas.

items.title: CorelDRAW
items.notes: Veteran vector illustration and layout software widely utilized in professional signmaking, apparel, and commercial print shops.

items.title: Gravit Designer
items.notes: Full-featured vector design app running smoothly in both modern web browsers and desktop environments with cloud project storage.

items.title: Boxy SVG
items.notes: Clean, browser-based and desktop SVG editor with an uncluttered UI tailored for web designers and developers.

items.title: Xara Designer Pro
items.notes: High-speed unified package combining vector illustration, DTP page layout, photo editing, and web graphics creation.

items.title: Adobe InDesign
items.notes: The industry-standard page design and layout application for books, digital magazines, flyers, interactive PDFs, and brochures.

items.title: QuarkXPress
items.notes: Pioneering desktop publishing and digital layout software with advanced typography control still heavily used in large print houses.

items.title: Affinity Publisher 2
items.notes: Next-gen desktop publishing software with StudioLink integration allowing live editing with Photo and Designer without app switching.

items.title: Canva
items.notes: Rapid in-browser graphic design and layout platform with tens of thousands of customizable drag-and-drop templates and team sharing.

items.title: Lucidpress (Marq)
items.notes: Web-based brand templating and multi-channel publication platform with lockable design elements to keep collateral on-brand.

items.title: LibreOffice Draw
items.notes: Free open-source vector drawing and basic page composition tool capable of editing PDFs, rendering flowcharts, and technical drawings.

items.title: Blurb BookWright
items.notes: Free publishing software built explicitly for formatting photo books, trade books, magazines, and e-books for on-demand print.

items.title: Scribus
items.notes: Open-source desktop publishing application featuring professional color management (CMYK, ICC profiles, spot colors) and PDF/X-3 export.

items.title: digiKam
items.notes: Comprehensive open-source digital asset management system with facial recognition, auto-tagging, geotagging, and RAW processing.

items.title: XnView MP
items.notes: Versatile, lightning-fast image viewer, cataloguer, and batch converter with support for over 500 graphic file formats.

items.title: FastStone Image Viewer
items.notes: Extremely fast, lightweight Windows image browser and viewer with side-by-side photo comparison, crop board, and full-screen preview.

items.title: IrfanView
items.notes: Legendary ultra-compact Windows graphic viewer designed to be fast, simple, and capable of handling enormous batch actions and plugins.

items.title: Adobe Bridge
items.notes: Powerful creative asset manager from Adobe allowing batch renaming, metadata tagging, rating, and Adobe Camera Raw previews without launch.

items.title: Zoner Photo Studio
items.notes: All-in-one photo workflow software for Windows providing DAM cataloging, RAW processing, layer-based editing, and basic video cutting.

items.title: Photo Mechanic
items.notes: The industry-fastest culling, tagging, and ingestion tool used worldwide by sports photographers, photojournalists, and agencies.

items.title: Aseprite
items.notes: The premier animated sprite editor and pixel art tool featuring onion skinning, tileset modes, palette swaps, and CLI export.

items.title: GraphicsGale
items.notes: Classic freeware animation and pixel graphics editor tailored for spriting, frame control, AVI/GIF output, and onion skinning.

items.title: Piskel
items.notes: Free online animated sprite and pixel art editor with live preview, frame management, and easy export to animated GIF or spritesheet.

items.title: Pixelorama
items.notes: Free and open-source pixel art and sprite animator built with the Godot Engine, featuring custom brushes, 3D layers, and timeline controls.

items.title: Hugin
items.notes: Open-source panorama photo stitcher and multi-row spherical image compositor based on the Panorama Tools library.

items.title: PTGui
items.notes: Gold-standard professional panorama stitching software with GPU acceleration, handling spherical 360x180 VR and gigapixel panoramas.

items.title: Nik Collection (DxO)
items.notes: Acclaimed suite of 8 photographic plugins (Silver Efex Pro, Color Efex Pro, Analog Efex, Viveza, Dfine) featuring U Point local adjustments.

items.title: Topaz Photo AI
items.notes: Integrated AI-powered image enhancement suite combining neural upscaling, RAW noise reduction, motion blur repair, and face recovery.

items.title: Topaz Gigapixel AI
items.notes: Dedicated standalone AI image upscaler capable of enlarging photos and textures up to 600% while synthesizing realistic detail.

items.title: Affinity Photo Develop Persona Plugins
items.notes: Macro packs, LUTs, and third-party plugin ecosystem designed for RAW development and non-destructive studio workflows in Affinity Photo 2.

items.title: Godot Engine 4.3
items.notes: Feature-packed, multi-platform 2D and 3D open-source game engine. Amazing node system and lightweight footprint.

items.title: Raymarching Signed Distance Fields
items.notes: Inigo Quilez distance functions cheatsheet and volumetric rendering algorithms. Perfect for procedural organic visuals.

items.notes: Heavy analog synth basslines, drum machines, and atmospheric neon pads suitable for retro sci-fi projects.

items.notes: Comprehensive architectural patterns for game loops, component systems, state machines, and spatial partitioning.
